cases.oracle: Original SU requirements, independently calculated Argon2id project-hex fixture and known vector, raw x86-64 UAPI requests, real /proc identity and descriptor observations, owned PTY modes, and exact child status. Device and credential results are synthetic; no root or kernel-enforcement conclusion is possible.
cases.comparison: The supervisor intercepts a valid SU token consume and supplies exactly one synthetic geteuid=0 to enter the client-only branch. It returns synthetic success only for the ordered setgroups([2000]), setresgid(2000,2000,2000), and setresuid(2000,2000,2000); no real credential call occurs. Invalid group/UID/GID attempts are denied, real identities are checked, and a setup control reaches a real owned bash exit 7. A private PTY drives only synthetic passwords; exact token bytes, response and transition records, execve argv/env/cwd/fds, and parent identities are retained. PR_SET_DUMPABLE is acknowledged without application so the peer can inspect owned tracees. Listener bootstrap is precompiled and sends its listener before supervised operations; diagnostic stage files record the handoff. The source-review ownership and embedded-payload guard repairs are included. The CLI raw and encoded outputs and exact inputs are independently cross-checked and recorded. Every PTY run records the complete before, each prompt-time and after termios snapshot. Cancellation records the selected notification, verified ancestry and UID/start-time recheck, pidfd details and signal outcome.
